name: Suzhou Kematek, Inc.
summary: Suzhou KemaTek, Inc. engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of various ceramic components in China and internationally. The company offers oxide, nitride, carbide, and machinable ceramics; surface treatment services; and metal structural components. Its products are applied in advanced equipment manufacturing, mechanical equipment, medical and pharmaceutical, new energy, electronic communications, as well as auto, textile, and chemical industries. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
